system.description:
Range: 30 spaces

You have learned the Blue Spirit's ability to whisper in the minds of others.

Choose a creature within 30 spaces. For 10 minutes, you can communicate telepathically with the target, transmitting words, sensory experiences and thoughts into their mind. The target can communicate back to you in the same manner.

This effect persists even if the target moves beyond 30 spaces away from you, or if you use this ability on other targets.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.kjVyanj0UAXSF8rL]{Blue Spirit's Whispers}
